verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a built-in 'research agent' that autonomously chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, and similar-papers retrieval on top of its search engine, plus Deep Search literature reviews and synthesis with citations — evidence of delegating multi-step research tasks to an in-product AI assistant. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of agentic task delegation, no detail on task scope/autonomy limits, and no explicit UI walkthrough of assigning a task to the assistant.
